name: Under Armour NCAA Pre-National Invitational
where: Terre Haute, IN · host Indiana State · LaVern Gibson Championship Cross Country Course
headline: Pre-Nationals: BYU edges NC State 84-88
summary: No. 2 BYU edged No. 1 NC State 84-88 on the LaVern Gibson course that hosts the NCAA Championships, with NC State's Hannah Gapes winning the women's race in 18:57.6; No. 7 Notre Dame was third (213). In the men's race, No. 8 Syracuse won with 115 ahead of No. 14 Villanova (127) and No. 15 Notre Dame (148), and Tulane's Silas Kiptanui won in 23:17.4.
